segments.name: Pakistan
products: Value added and call completion services
segments.description: Provides mobile and fixed-line telecommunications, wireless internet access and mobile financial services to consumer and business customers in Pakistan.
segments.evidence: VEON provides mobile telecommunication services to its customers in Pakistan, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Bangladesh and Uzbekistan.

segments.name: Ukraine
products: Value added and call completion services
segments.description: Provides mobile and fixed-line telecommunications, wireless internet access, mobile bundles and digital services to customers in Ukraine.
segments.evidence: We also provide fixed-line telecommunications services in Pakistan, Ukraine, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan as well as business-to-consumer and business-to-business OTT (over-the-top) services on mobile and fixed networks in each of our markets.

segments.name: Kazakhstan
products: Value added and call completion services
segments.description: Provides mobile and fixed-line telecommunications, wireless internet access and mobile financial services to consumer and business customers in Kazakhstan.
segments.evidence: Our reportable segments currently consist of the following five geographic segments: Pakistan; Ukraine; Kazakhstan; Uzbekistan; and Bangladesh.

segments.name: Uzbekistan
products: Value added and call completion services
segments.description: Provides mobile and fixed-line telecommunications, wireless internet access and mobile financial services to consumer and business customers in Uzbekistan.
segments.evidence: VEON's reportable segments currently consist of the following five segments: Pakistan, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Bangladesh and Uzbekistan.

segments.name: Bangladesh
products: Value added and call completion services
segments.description: Provides mobile telecommunications, wireless internet access, roaming and mobile bundles to consumer and business customers in Bangladesh.
segments.evidence: As per regulation, mobile network operators are not allowed to provide mobile financial services in Bangladesh.

revenueModel.text: Mobile subscribers pay VEON for prepaid and postpaid connectivity, data, value-added services and mobile bundles across its operating markets.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary source of revenue comes from prepaid mobile customers, who are not required to enter into long-term fixed contracts, and we cannot be certain that these customers will continue to use our services and at the usage levels we expect.

changes.text: In 2025 VEON sold its operations in Kyrgyzstan, which are no longer a reportable segment.
changes.evidence: VEON's operations in Kyrgyzstan were sold during the year ended December 31, 2025

changes.text: In 2025 VEON acquired Uklon, which is part of the Ukraine operating segment.
changes.evidence: In March 2025, we acquired Uklon, which improved our digital revenue performance during the year ended December 31, 2025.

changes.text: In 2024 VEON sold its stake in TNS Plus LLP, which was included within the Kazakhstan operating segment.
